title: Workspace trust management with history UX and emergency revoke
objective: Add workspace trust management, class-labeled approval history UX, and emergency revoke on top of the SG-000018 replay-resistant foundation and SG-000019 STRONG enforcement, so trust changes are explicit, auditable, and STRONG-gated with fail-closed revocation, without weakening one-shot, expiry, digest binding, or STRONG presence.

include: workspace trust creation, modification, and revocation through dedicated PRIVILEGED APIs bound to STRONG approval with fresh nonce, expiry, one-shot, digest, workspace, and policy bindings
approval history UX beyond recorded fields with bounded redacted queries preserving class and presence labels
emergency revoke broadcast that invalidates pending approvals fail-closed without authorizing new operations
trust and revoke history recording without secret material
deterministic unit and security tests for trust changes, revoke invalidation, history UX redaction, replay and drift retention, and separation
retention of all SG-000018 one-shot, expiry, digest, history, and SG-000019 STRONG enforcement with no behavior change outside trust and revoke
exclude: new privileged capabilities outside workspace trust management
changes to per-operation digests, prompts, or summaries outside trust and revoke labeling
new network, browser, UI automation, clipboard, or installer authority
approval delegation to remote or MCP callers
synthetic-input generation or input injection of any kind

authority_delta.filesystem: Trust state appends bounded records to Cotra protected local state; workspace files, Git state, and unrelated paths gain no new writability.
authority_delta.process: No new process authority. Trust decisions are policy records, not process execution.
authority_delta.network: None. Trust management and revoke are strictly local with no egress.
authority_delta.ui_input: None. No input injection is added; trust decisions are accepted only through the local approval authority with STRONG presence where required.
authority_delta.secrets: Trust and revoke records carry identifiers and digests only. Raw secrets and biometric material never enter prompts, records, history, logs, or audit.
authority_delta.approval: Workspace trust changes require STRONG approval. Emergency revoke invalidates pending approvals fail-closed. No persistent reuse or remote delegation is introduced.
authority_delta.privileged: Workspace trust management only, through dedicated PRIVILEGED APIs with STRONG presence. No other privilege is added.

invariants: Workspace trust changes require STRONG approval and fail closed without verified presence
Emergency revoke invalidates pending approvals fail-closed and never authorizes execution
History UX preserves redaction and tamper-evident loading with class and presence labels retained
STRONG enforcement, one-shot, expiry, digest, workspace, and policy bindings are not weakened
The agent cannot produce a valid trust change through MCP tools, synthetic input, UI automation, coordinates, or child processes
No trust-change bypass, persistent reuse, remote delegation, browser, UI, network, or elevation authority is introduced

acceptance.claim: Tests prove workspace trust creation, modification, and revocation require STRONG approval and fail closed without verified presence.
Tests prove emergency revoke invalidates pending approvals fail-closed and never authorizes execution.
Tests prove history UX returns bounded redacted records with class and presence labels and rejects tampered records.
Tests prove the agent cannot satisfy trust changes through MCP tools, synthetic input, UI automation, coordinate proposals, child processes, or replayed prior approvals.
Tests prove replay, expiry, digest mismatch, revision drift, and double-consumption protections remain enforced for both classes.
Tests prove denied and unavailable trust and revoke decisions are recorded and never authorize execution.
Tests prove all P06 approval flows and SG-000018/019 regressions still pass with digests unchanged outside trust labeling.
Tests prove broader process, network, browser, UI, clipboard, installer, and elevation authority remain unreachable.

Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu Rust, Node, Governance, genuine TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, exact-diff security review, manual review of excluded security-sensitive files, and zero unresolved blocking review threads all pass.

successor_requirements.p07_exit: COTRA-P07 exits when trust management, history UX, and emergency revoke are proven on top of STRONG enforcement with replay and drift resistance, which this grain must jointly satisfy with SG-000018 and SG-000019.

done_when: Workspace trust management with STRONG-gated changes, class-labeled history UX, and emergency revoke is merged with fail-closed invalidation, agent-forgery tests, retained replay and drift enforcement, and no new platform authority beyond trust records.
